title: Brownies
description: Brownies is a dish from United States prepared with chicken egg, all-purpose flour. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Beat the listed ingredients until pale and light; ensure butter and eggs are at room temperature when specified.
Melt the dark chocolate gently and cool slightly before folding it with flour and cocoa into the creamed egg-butter mixture; do not overmix.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 28 minutes until set and cooked through.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 35 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
